title: cymbopogon microstachys
intro: Cymbopogon microstachys, commonly known as East Indian lemon grass, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. It is native to tropical Asia and is widely cultivated for its essential oil, which is used in traditional medicine and perfumery. The health benefits of Cymbopogon microstachys include its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been shown to aid in the treatment of digestive issues and fever. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including citral, limonene, and beta-pinene, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
